successCriteria.description: LeaveRequest entity interface exists with fields: id, employeeId, leavePolicyId, startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string | undefined), status (LeaveStatus), approvedBy (string | null), approvedAt (Date | null), cancelledBy (string | null), cancelledAt (Date | null), createdAt, updatedAt — and imports LeaveStatus from 'shared/types'
CreateLeaveRequestDto, UpdateLeaveRequestDto (partial), and LeaveRequestQueryParams (employeeId?, status?, leavePolicyId?, startDate?, endDate?) are exported from the model file
ILeaveRequestRepository extends IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest> and declares findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findOverlapping, findByDateRange, findPendingForManager
findOverlapping uses the BINDING inclusive-day overlap formula: existing.startDate <= newEndDate AND existing.endDate >= newStartDate
ILeaveRequestService declares create, submit, approve, reject, cancel, update, getById, query, getEmployeeRequests

submit validates employee is ACTIVE via IEmployeeService.isActive, validates policy is active via ILeavePolicyService, checks minimumNoticeDays (skipped for emergency leave), checks for overlapping requests via findOverlapping, computes daysRequested = (endDate - startDate) + 1, and checks sufficient balance via ILeaveBalanceService.getRemainingDays
approve deducts days from LeaveBalance using the inclusive formula, sets approvedBy and approvedAt, and transitions status to APPROVED
reject transitions status to REJECTED with no balance change
Fiscal year = calendar year of startDate; cross-year requests charge entirely to startDate's fiscal year
cancel from APPROVED restores days to LeaveBalance and sets cancelledBy/cancelledAt; cancel from SUBMITTED or DRAFT makes no balance change

constraints: LeaveRequestService constructor MUST inject IEmployeeService, ILeavePolicyService, ILeaveBalanceService, and ILeaveRequestRepository — no other dependencies
All database access for leave-request goes through ILeaveRequestRepository — no inline SQL or ORM calls in service or controller
Controller MUST use Zod for request validation at the API boundary (GP-003)
